transcript.content:
Now I have a clear understanding of the bug. The `_is_jupyter()` function in `rich/console.py` at line 511 only recognizes `ZMQInteractiveShell` (Jupyter notebook/qtconsole) and `"google.colab"` as Jupyter environments. However, Databricks uses the base class `InteractiveShell`, which doesn't match either condition, so it falls through to the `else` clause and returns `False`.

The fix is to modify the `_is_jupyter()` function to also recognize `InteractiveShell` (the base class) as a Jupyter-like environment, since Databricks and potentially other platforms use this class name.
